recipe_cards.name: Grilled Chicken Thighs w/ Tabbouleh, Hummus & Turmeric Rice
recipe_cards.nonna_says: You make the marinade first. Olive oil, soy sauce, garlic, a little brown sugar, smoked paprika, cumin, a squeeze of lemon. Mix it with your hands, not a whisk. Coat those thighs and let them sit in the fridge at least two hours, overnight if you can. Get the grill hot, medium-high, oil the grates. Lay the chicken down and don't you dare touch it for six minutes. Flip once, cook another six. You want char marks and juicy inside, not rubber. While it rests, toss your tabbouleh with more lemon than you think you need. If your hummus came from a plastic tub, I won't say anything, but I'll know.

variations.name: Za'atar & Lemon Grilled Chicken
variations.twist: Replace the marinade with za'atar, sumac, lemon juice, and olive oil for a tangy, herbal Middle Eastern flavor profile.

variations.name: Tahini-Honey Grilled Chicken Thighs
variations.twist: Marinate in tahini, honey, lemon, and coriander for a creamy, nutty crust that caramelizes beautifully on the grill.

variations.name: Sumac & Allspice Palestinian-Style Thighs
variations.twist: Season with sumac, Aleppo pepper, allspice, and garlic for a musakhan-inspired warmth, served with pickled onions and charred lemon.

groups.merge_action: Whisk into marinade
Coat in marinade, refrigerate 2 hours or overnight

final_steps: Oil grill grates, place chicken skin-side down
Grill 6-7 min per side undisturbed until charred
Internal temp 165F, rest 5 min before serving

groups.merge_action: Pour water over bulgur, cover 15 min, fluff
Toss vegetables and herbs with dressed bulgur
Toast rice in butter with turmeric 1 min, add water, bring to boil, cover, simmer 15 min

final_steps: Fluff rice with fork
Plate chicken over turmeric rice with tabbouleh and hummus alongside

recipe_cards.name: Corned Beef Hash with Fried Eggs & Toast
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Cut the potatoes into little cubes, boil them with vinegar and salt until just tender, and drain them good. Melt butter in your heaviest skillet, medium-high. Soften the onions and peppers first, then add the potatoes and press them flat. Now here's where everybody messes up. Stop. Touching. The. Hash. Let it sit and get crispy on the bottom, five, six minutes. Then fold in the corned beef, press it down again, and let it crust up one more time. Top each plate with a fried egg, runny yolk, and good toast. You earned this breakfast.

variations.name: Sweet Potato Corned Beef Hash
variations.twist: Swap Yukon Golds for sweet potatoes and add a pinch of chipotle for a smoky-sweet version that's surprisingly addictive.

variations.name: Cheesy Baked Hash Casserole
variations.twist: Transfer the hash to a baking dish, top with cheddar and chives, and bake until bubbly for a crowd-friendly brunch dish.

variations.name: Kimchi Corned Beef Hash
variations.twist: Fold in chopped kimchi and finish with sesame oil and scallions for a Korean-American fusion that wakes everything up.

groups.merge_action: Boil potatoes in vinegar water until just tender (5 min), drain well
Melt butter over medium-high, cook onion and pepper until softened (3-4 min)
Add drained potatoes, press flat, crisp 6-8 min undisturbed. Fold in corned beef, press flat again, crisp 5 min more.

final_steps: Season to taste
Serve with crispy fried eggs on top
Toast on the side, hot sauce optional

recipe_cards.name: Babo Pasta (Homemade Spinach Pasta with Egg Yolks)
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Thaw your spinach, squeeze every last drop of water out with a towel until your hands are green and tired. Make a mountain of flour with a well in the middle. Crack in the eggs, add the spinach, a pinch of salt, and pull the flour in a little at a time until it becomes a shaggy mess that you knead into silk. Six minutes with the dough hook if you have a mixer, ten by hand. Wrap it up and let it rest, thirty minutes, no peeking. Roll it thin through the machine, cut it however you like, and cook it fresh in boiling salted water for two minutes. Butter, good Parm, maybe some of the pasta water to bring it together. That's Babo Pasta night, and nobody gets to skip it.

variations.name: Paglia e Fieno (Straw and Hay Pasta)
variations.twist: Make half the batch with regular egg dough and half with spinach, toss both together with peas, prosciutto, and cream sauce.

variations.name: Spinach Pasta with Walnut Cream Sauce
variations.twist: Blend toasted walnuts with garlic, Parm, and cream into a rich, nutty sauce that makes the green pasta sing.

variations.name: Spinach Pasta with Bolognese
variations.twist: Pair your green fettuccine with a slow-simmered beef and sausage Bolognese for an Emilia-Romagna classic.

groups.merge_action: Microwave 2.5-3 min to thaw, drain, squeeze with towels until no liquid remains
Combine flour, salt, eggs, and dried spinach in mixer with dough hook. Mix on low until combined, knead on speed 2 for 6 min.

final_steps: Knead by hand 2 min on floured surface until smooth
Wrap in plastic, rest 30 min at room temperature
Cut dough into 4 pieces, roll through pasta machine from widest to setting 4
Cut into fettuccine or desired shape
Boil in salted water 2-3 min until tender

parallel_table.note: While pasta cooks, prepare the sauce:

groups.merge_action: Melt butter in large skillet, add pasta water, toss drained pasta, add Parm and pepper, toss until creamy

final_steps: Serve immediately with extra Parm at the table

recipe_cards.name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes with Berry Compote
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Whisk the ricotta, milk, egg yolks, melted butter, vanilla, and lemon zest until it's smooth and smells like a good morning. In another bowl, the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar get a quick mix. Fold the dry into the wet, gently. Now beat those egg whites to stiff peaks and fold them in like you're tucking a baby into bed. That air is everything. Medium-low heat, butter in the pan, quarter cup per pancake. Wait for the bubbles, flip once, don't press down on them. Serve with warm berries and a little powdered sugar if you're feeling fancy. These pancakes are clouds, honey, actual clouds.

variations.name: Lemon Poppy Seed Ricotta Pancakes
variations.twist: Stir 2 tablespoons of poppy seeds into the batter for a bakery-style crunch that turns brunch into something special.

variations.name: Blueberry Ricotta Pancakes
variations.twist: Fold a cup of fresh blueberries into the batter for juicy, fruity bursts that turn golden and jammy on the griddle.

variations.name: Orange Ricotta Pancakes with Mascarpone
variations.twist: Swap lemon zest for orange zest and serve with sweetened whipped mascarpone for an Italian-brunch elevation.

groups.merge_action: Whisk ricotta, milk, egg yolks, melted butter, vanilla, and zest until smooth
Whisk dry ingredients, fold gently into wet mixture
Fold whipped whites into batter in two additions, keeping it light and airy

final_steps: Butter griddle, drop 1/4 cup batter per pancake
Cook 2-3 min until bubbles form, flip, cook 1-2 min more
Keep warm in 200F oven while finishing batch

parallel_table.note: Make the berry compote while pancakes cook:

groups.merge_action: Simmer all together in a small saucepan over medium heat 8-10 min, stirring occasionally, until berries burst and sauce thickens

final_steps: Spoon warm compote over pancakes
Dust with powdered sugar, serve with maple syrup

recipe_cards.name: Chicken & Charred Corn Street Tacos with Elote Crema
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Season the chicken thighs with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and a squeeze of lime. Get a cast iron screaming hot with a little oil and sear those thighs until they've got real color, about five minutes a side. While they rest, same pan, throw in the corn kernels and don't stir them for three minutes so they get that black char. Mix your crema: mayo, sour cream, lime juice, chili powder, a clove of garlic grated in. Slice the chicken thin against the grain. Warm your tortillas on the flame, pile them high, drizzle the crema, crumble the cotija, cilantro, done. This is Tuesday night dinner that tastes like a party.

variations.name: Al Pastor-Style Chicken Tacos
variations.twist: Marinate chicken in adobo, pineapple juice, and guajillo chili for a sweet, smoky al pastor spin with grilled pineapple.

variations.name: Baja Fish Tacos with Elote Slaw
variations.twist: Swap chicken for beer-battered white fish and turn the charred corn into a crunchy slaw with cabbage and lime.

variations.name: Chipotle-Lime Chicken Tacos with Avocado Crema
variations.twist: Add chipotle peppers to the marinade and blend avocado into the crema for a smoky, creamy, dairy-free alternative.

engineer_table.preheat: Cast iron skillet over high heat

groups.merge_action: Rub chicken with spices, oil, and lime. Sear in hot cast iron 5 min per side. Rest 5 min, slice thin against grain.
Same hot skillet, cook corn undisturbed 3 min until charred, toss and char 2 min more
Stir together into elote crema

final_steps: Warm 12 corn tortillas on open flame or dry skillet
Fill with sliced chicken and charred corn
Drizzle crema, crumble cotija cheese, top with cilantro and lime wedges

recipe_cards.name: Homemade Ricotta-Herb Ravioli with Brown Butter Sage Sauce
recipe_cards.nonna_says: Make the dough first. Flour mountain, well in the center, crack in the eggs, olive oil, pinch of salt, and pull the flour in slowly until it comes together. Knead it ten minutes, wrap it, let it rest. For the filling, mix your ricotta with Parm, an egg, parsley, basil, a whisper of nutmeg, salt and pepper. Roll the dough thin, thin, thin through the machine. Spoon little mounds of filling two inches apart, brush water around each one, lay the top sheet, press out the air, and cut. Boil them gently, three minutes, they float when they're done. Brown your butter with whole sage leaves until it smells like heaven and the leaves go crispy. Toss the ravioli in, grate more Parm on top. This is date night. You've earned it.

variations.name: Butternut Squash Ravioli with Brown Butter
variations.twist: Fill with roasted butternut squash, amaretti crumbs, and nutmeg for a sweet, autumnal ravioli that's pure northern Italy.

variations.name: Ricotta Ravioli with Burst Cherry Tomatoes
variations.twist: Skip the brown butter and toss ravioli with burst cherry tomatoes, garlic, basil, and olive oil for a lighter, summery finish.

variations.name: Ravioli with Brown Butter, Sage & Hazelnuts
variations.twist: Add toasted hazelnuts to the brown butter sage sauce for a nutty crunch that elevates the dish to restaurant territory.

groups.merge_action: Form flour well, add eggs/oil/salt, incorporate gradually, knead 8-10 min until smooth and elastic. Wrap, rest 30 min.
Mix filling until just combined, chill 15 min

final_steps: Roll dough thin (second-to-last pasta machine setting)
Place 1 tbsp filling mounds 2 inches apart, brush water around each
Top with second sheet, press to seal removing air, cut with wheel or knife
Boil ravioli in salted water 2-3 min until they float

parallel_table.note: While ravioli boil, make the sauce:

groups.merge_action: Melt butter over medium heat, add sage, swirl until butter turns golden-brown and sage is crispy (3-4 min). Optional: stir in lemon juice.

final_steps: Transfer ravioli directly into brown butter with a spider or slotted spoon
Toss gently to coat
Plate and finish with grated Parm and cracked pepper

recipe_cards.name: Udon Soup with Premade Soup Dumplings
recipe_cards.nonna_says: I know, I know, this isn't Italian, but a good broth is a good broth and I respect it. Soak your kombu in cold water ten minutes, then bring it up slow, medium heat, and pull it out right before it boils. Drop in the bonito flakes, let them steep a couple minutes, strain everything out. Now you've got dashi. Add soy sauce, mirin, a little sugar, a pinch of salt. Taste it. It should be clean and savory and warm. Cook your udon, steam your dumplings, put it all in a big bowl, pour the hot broth over. Green onions, a soft egg if you want. Simple things done right, that's what good cooking is.

variations.name: Curry Udon Soup
variations.twist: Stir Japanese curry roux into the dashi broth for a rich, velvety, warmly spiced soup that's pure comfort food.

variations.name: Kimchi Udon Soup
variations.twist: Add kimchi, gochujang, and sliced pork to the broth for a spicy Korean-Japanese fusion bowl.

variations.name: Miso Butter Udon
variations.twist: Whisk white miso and a knob of butter into the broth for a rich, umami-loaded bowl topped with corn and scallions.

groups.merge_action: Soak kombu in water 10 min. Heat slowly over medium, remove kombu just before boiling. Add bonito flakes, simmer 1-2 min, steep 2-3 min, strain through fine sieve.
Add seasonings to strained dashi, warm gently over medium-low, adjust to taste

final_steps: Cook udon noodles per package directions, drain
Steam premade soup dumplings per package directions
Divide udon among bowls, ladle hot broth over
Top with soup dumplings, sliced green onions, soft-boiled egg, nori strips
